title: Six-Minute Walk Test (6MWT) - FAA Result Sheet

blocks.text: Please have the provider who treats your cardiac or pulmonary condition complete this sheet. The test must be done in accordance with the American Thoracic Society (ATS) Guidelines for the Six-Minute Walk Test . In most cases, a minimum of 400 m is required for medical certification/clearance.
